notes.title: DLC RELEASE - Fredo's Games OUT NOW!!
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers!

We're VERY happy to finally release the very first DLC for Worlds of Aria! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3325450/Worlds_of_Aria_Fredos_Games/

The Great Aria Games are starting soon, and Fredo Bargains is counting on you to win first prize!

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*]A new playable character - Take control of Fredo Bargains, the charismatic and cunning impresario cat.
[*]6 brand-new story chapters - Explore Altabianca, Ashanul, and more to recruit the best team and win the Great Aria Games.
[*]More choices, more chaos - Engage in new roleplaying scenarios filled with clever trades, double-crosses, and theatrical flair.
[/list]


And don't forget, if you own the DLC, you can invite your friends to play with you for free thanks to the Friends Pass!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers!
First of all, we want to thank each and every one of you for the great love and support we've been getting since the release. We now have 91% positive reviews on Steam, which we're very proud of.

This new update should fix the remaining bugs and issues we've received. We might have one or two more hotfix to make after this one, but now our next big focus will be on the DLCs :) (and don't worry, we'll have some exciting news about the Switch version VERY soon).

And now, time for the patch notes!
[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] When a character or an item is lost under the table, they will automatically be brought back on the table
[*] Minor visual improvements on the character sheet
[*] The controller navigation in the progression screens has been improved
[*] Now, when the users don't have the same game version, they will get a message
[/list]

[h2]Twitch[/h2]
[list]
[*] if there's no vote, the character controlled by the chat will not move until the end of the timer set by the player
[*] The Twitch timer settings have been changed
[/list]

[h2]Achievement[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the "Saved all NPC" achievement
[*] Fixed the achievements linked to the "All stars" during the scenario
[*] Fixed the "King of Aria" achievement
[/list]

[h2]Bug fix[/h2]
[*] Fix a visual glitch that appeared on the bug report menu
[*] Fix various Story branches
[*] Fix wrong stars showing at the start of a scene

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Worlds of Aria Release Date: September 24
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers!

We are thrilled to announce Worlds of Aria will release on [b]September 24 on PC![/b] You will also be able to play with your friends thanks to the Buddy Pass! We will get into more details about it in the weeks to come, but first: enjoy our brand new trailer!

[previewyoutube=jS4gZ-k2Q2U;full][LINK TRAILER][/previewyoutube]
Worlds of Aria is a light fantasy adventure to play with your family & friends. Inspired by tabletop RPGs, we’ve created a game [b]accessible to everyone[/b] with a wide variety of characters, possible stories and outcomes: on September 24, you’ll get it all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/037acff59b89ff66e8126e33722e801b150fbba4.jpg[/img]

Are you curious about the game? Play the demo with your friends! It’s available right now for you to try [b]the first three Chapters[/b] of the story!

Do not hesitate to wishlist the game, as it helps us a LOT to get more visibility on Steam to reach more players who would enjoy our game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866980/Worlds_of_Aria/

We’ll see you on September 24 for the launch!

In the meantime, feel free to [url=https://discord.com/invite/QumwzBy4nx]join our Discord server[/url]! Maybe you’ll find some friends to play with at the release 👀

notes.title: About the release of Worlds of Aria
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers!

We hope you’re all okay! We hope you’ve enjoyed going back to the demo of Worlds of Aria for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1866980/view/3676678674663369597]Steam Strategy Fest[/url]. 

[h2]Release of Worlds of Aria[/h2]

We have some news to share with you regarding the release of Worlds of Aria. The quality performance and the gameplay of Worlds of Aria is one of our top priorities, and we need just a bit more time to ensure that we release the game that you deserve to have.

This means that we’ve taken the decision to [b]release Worlds of Aria in Early 2024[/b]. We appreciate your understanding and hope you’re as excited as we are to finally bring the Worlds of Aria to life in a few months!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/c7ef70646ea33217832caa756ed071730bab3df5.png[/img]

[h2]The music of the game[/h2]

As you know, French composer/content creator [b]MisterMV (Xavier Dang)[/b] was supposed to create some music for the game on top of voicing Belladonna, MicGivrey and Raoul in French. However, because of schedule issues, he will only be able to create the main theme of the game and do the voice-acting work. 

However, we're very excited to announce that French composer [b]Louis Godart[/b] will replace him to create the best soundtrack for the game.

You may have heard him in [b]Pharaoh: A New Era[/b] or [b]Blanc[/b]! And here's a small snippets of what you will be able to hear in the game:
[list]
[*] [url=https://soundcloud.com/lgodart/enmer-aventure-wip/s-sDWfqHMrNeL?si=822f7a4061ee47fb8f2188c391250b3f&utm_source=clipboard&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=social_sharing]Louis Godart - En Mer (WIP)[/url]
[*] [url=https://soundcloud.com/lgodart/grandduc-boss-wip/s-eVzCEVeoGAt?si=822f7a4061ee47fb8f2188c391250b3f&utm_source=clipboard&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=social_sharing]Louis Godart - Grand Duc (WIP)[/url]
[/list]
[h2]New Demo[/h2]

We're also very happy to announce that very SOON, you’ll be able to have a new glimpse of what the game will offer. We’re very happy to announce that [b]a NEW demo will be available in a few weeks[/b] on Steam. Please stay tuned for more news about this new demo.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866980/Worlds_of_Aria/

Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments or on our [url=https://discord.gg/JZJknmH3zM]Discord server[/url]!
